Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + logs request (post-call) — Finlytics integration

Thanks again for the demo today — really helpful to see the pipeline. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Goal: get a safe production-grade integration running for embeddings + reranker + tool-calling by end of Q3.
- Primary ask today: we saw several 5xx errors in the logs you shared during the call; to triage we need a minimal repro and the raw request/response snippets.

Would you be able to: 
1) attach the server logs and a single failing HTTP request (curl/httpie) that reproduces the 5xx?
2) confirm which Redwood SDK you’re using (redwood-js / redwood-py) and the SDK version + any client-side timeout overrides?
3) confirm whether you’re using structured output/tool calling for the reranker step or post-processing server-side?

Initial thoughts from our side (so you know what we’ll check): authentication header format, payload size (large tool argument blobs can trigger backend timeouts), and routing to model variants under load.

I’m looping in Neha and Jordan from Solutions/SE and Rishi from Engineering to help triage. If you can include a repro-request.http (or curl) and a 10–20 line log segment we’ll take a first pass and get back with concrete repro steps.

Thanks — talk soon.

—Marissa

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the quick follow-up.

We are using redwood-js v1.4.2 (installed via npm) and had the client timeout at the default (30s). We reproduced the 5xx during a batch reranker call that also triggers tool-calling for structured enrichment.

Attached are two files: server-logs.txt (trimmed around the incidents) and repro-request.http (single request we used to repro locally). 

Snippet from server-logs.txt showing a failing request: 

[2026-07-02T12:22:11.123Z] request_id=fb3c8e4a model=redwood-mixed-32k status=502 backend=llm-instance-7 path=/v1/generate duration_ms=30123
[2026-07-02T12:22:11.124Z] payload_size=1.8MB tools_included=3 embeddings_count=10 reranker=true

Contents of repro-request.http (we attached full file): a POST to https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate with Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED> and body including input document and a tools array (each tool has large schema).

We tried bumping the client timeout to 60s in one test and still saw intermittent 502s. Happy to share anything else — we’re blocked from going further until this is stable.

Ben Jacobs

Forwarding Finlytics’ repro. Key points:
- redwood-js v1.4.2, default timeout 30s (they tried 60s, still intermittent).
- payload_size ~1.8MB, tools_included=3, embeddings_count=10, reranker enabled.
- backend observed: llm-instance-7 returning 502 after ~30s. request_id=fb3c8e4a

Ask: can you triage and advise fast remediation steps we can recommend to the customer (config, SDK guidance, routing/timeout changes) and whether we should enable canary routing to another model variant on their account? Also someone from infra please confirm if llm-instance-7 had any known issues at that time.

I’ll coordinate customer comms once we have a recommended repro workflow.

—Marissa

On Thu, Jul 2, 2026 at 09:03 AM Ben Jacobs <ben@finlytics.com> wrote:
> (original message and attachments)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 02:18:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: Finlytics 5xx — repro + logs

Thanks for the ping — dug into the attachments. Quick triage notes: 

1) Logs / pattern: the request_id fb3c8e4a shows duration ~30s and a 502 from llm-instance-7. That backend typically indicates the model worker aborted while building the response (OOM or internal timeout). Given payload_size=1.8MB + 3 tools with nested schemas, the worker likely hit a CPU/memory pressure point during JSON serialization + tool argument expansion.

2) Immediate mitigations to recommend to Finlytics (low-effort):
   - Increase client-side timeout to 90s for these heavy reranker/tool calls (we should note this buys them time but not fix the root).
   - Reduce batch size / embeddings_count per request (split the reranker job into smaller chunks, e.g., 3–4 embeddings per call).
   - Remove or minimize large tool payloads: pass tool identifiers and fetch the schema server-side, or compress the tool arguments.

3) Long-term fixes (we can offer as engineering tasks):
   - Server-side: route heavy requests to a variant with larger memory (redwood-mixed-64k) or enable fallback routing when worker shows repeated 5xxs. We can provision a canary rule for their account.
   - SDK: add request-level streaming and partial responses for tool calls (reduces peak memory usage).

4) Repro request: I ran the repro-request.http locally against a staging router and reproduced a 502 when the tools array contained >2 tools with ~400KB schemas each. To make an isolated repro for Engineering: please have Finlytics send a minimal request with:
   - single document input (short)
   - tools array with one tool whose arguments are a 200–400KB JSON payload (we can provide a generator)
   - header X-Request-ID: <uuid> and include Authorization header

I added a short curl they can run: 

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: test-repro-502-01" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '@repro-minimal.json' 

Where repro-minimal.json is the reduced payload. If Finlytics can run that and paste the returned request_id, we’ll trace it in infra logs and confirm whether it’s the same worker cluster.

5) Infra ask: Rishi — can you check llm-instance-7 worker health around 2026-07-02T12:20–12:25Z and confirm if any OOMs or restarts were recorded? If so, we should notify Finlytics that automatic fallback is recommended and we can spin up a larger-memory variant for them temporarily.

I can draft a short customer note with the mitigations and repro steps.

—Jordan
Staff Engineer, Inference Runtime

Thanks Jordan — this is great context.

We ran your minimal repro flow with X-Request-ID and increased SDK timeout to 90s. Still seeing intermittent 502s but now we have the new request IDs and a clearer correlation to the llm-instance-7 group. New example from our logs: 

[2026-07-03T09:14:44.987Z] request_id=test-repro-502-01 model=redwood-mixed-32k status=502 backend=llm-instance-7 duration_ms=45211

We’d like to proceed with the following (please confirm feasibility & ETA):
- Enable canary routing for our account to a larger-memory variant (redwood-mixed-64k) for the next 72 hours.
- Recommended SDK guidance we can ship in our release notes (timeout recommendation + batching best practices).

We’re on a tight timeline; if you can enable the canary and confirm when it’s active we’ll re-run the tests. Appreciate the quick help — will share the new logs as soon as we have them.

Ben
Senior Product Manager | Finlytics
